fusions.name: Held by the Scruff
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and hacks down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Fall
fusions.desc: Brings the haft down in both fists, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Down
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Grip Back
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
